CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation (A) bound to identified content.

COD.rationale: Content (red) and organization/presentation (current record and coordinate orientation) and a separate origin/status field are all explicitly present for p0/current/n0.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition is related to the identified contents' presentation or access.

C.rationale: The report explicitly names represented contents with attributes (red/blue) for current and candidate records.

D.rationale: Origin/status metadata is listed separately from the content values for the same referent/time, distinguishing content identity from status/organization.

O.rationale: The text states display coordinate orientation and presents how contents are represented in current records (positions), indicating organization/presentation/access.
